skills.label: Configure cloud environments
skills.desc: Configure cloud environments for Claude Code cloud sessions: network access levels, environment variables, setup scripts, and environment caching. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments

skills.label: Use Claude Code with a screen reader
skills.desc: Set up Claude Code for screen readers such as VoiceOver and NVDA, plus settings for screen magnifiers, reduced motion, and colorblind-friendly themes. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/accessibility

skills.label: Fullscreen rendering
skills.desc: Enable a smoother, flicker-free rendering mode with mouse support and stable memory usage in long conversations. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fullscreen

skills.label: Customize keyboard shortcuts
skills.desc: Customize keyboard shortcuts in Claude Code with a keybindings configuration file. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/keybindings

skills.label: Customize your status line
skills.desc: Configure a custom status bar to monitor context window usage, costs, and git status in Claude Code Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline

skills.label: Configure your terminal for Claude Code
skills.desc: Fix Shift+Enter for newlines, get a terminal bell when Claude finishes, configure tmux, match the color theme, and enable Vim mode in the Claude Code CLI. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/terminal-config

skills.label: Voice dictation
skills.desc: Speak your prompts in the Claude Code CLI with hold-to-record or tap-to-record voice dictation. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/voice-dictation

skills.label: Escalate hard decisions with the advisor tool
skills.desc: Pair your main model with a stronger advisor model that Claude consults at key moments during a task. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/advisor

skills.label: Speed up responses with fast mode
skills.desc: Get faster Opus responses in Claude Code by toggling fast mode. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode

skills.label: Model configuration
skills.desc: Configure which model Claude Code uses, effort levels, extended context, and the auto-compact window Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config

skills.label: Output styles
skills.desc: Change Claude Code's role, tone, and response format with a built-in output style such as Concise or Explanatory, or write a custom style. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles

skills.label: Auto mode classifier request charges
skills.desc: Resolve the Claude Code notice saying this session isn't eligible for auto mode's no-charge classifier requests: what it means, why it appears, and what to do. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing

skills.label: Choose a permission mode
skills.desc: Control whether Claude asks before acting. Switch permission modes with Shift+Tab in the CLI, the mode indicator in VS Code, or the mode selector in Desktop. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

skills.label: Configure permissions
skills.desc: Control what Claude Code can access and do with fine-grained permission rules, modes, and managed policies. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions

skills.label: Choose a sandbox environment
skills.desc: Compare Claude Code sandbox options: the built-in sandboxed Bash tool, sandbox runtime, dev containers, Docker, and VMs. Choose the right isolation for your threat model. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandbox-environments

skills.label: Configure the sandboxed Bash tool
skills.desc: Restrict the files and network hosts Claude Code's shell commands can reach with the built-in sandbox. Turn it on, set the boundary, and fix what it breaks. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing

skills.label: Self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Run Claude Code cloud sessions on infrastructure you control: set up a self-hosted environment, deploy runners, and route sessions to your own compute. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments

skills.label: Customize sessions in self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Customize self-hosted environment sessions with wrapper scripts for per-session credentials, lifecycle hooks, and on-demand runner spawning. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-configuration

skills.label: Deploy self-hosted environments to production
skills.desc: Run self-hosted runners in production: security hardening, network egress control, git credentials, Kubernetes and Compose recipes, and troubleshooting. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-deploy

skills.label: Verify session identity in self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Verify the CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ACCESS_TOKEN JWT so services on your network can trust requests from sessions in your self-hosted environment. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-identity

skills.label: Self-hosted environments quickstart
skills.desc: Set up your first self-hosted environment: install Claude Code, create the environment, start a runner, and route a session to it. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-quickstart

skills.label: Self-hosted environments reference
skills.desc: Complete reference for the self-hosted runner and orchestrator: CLI flags, environment variables, and Prometheus metrics. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-reference

skills.label: Test self-hosted environments end to end
skills.desc: Verify a self-hosted runner image from CI: dispatch a session with the CLI, read Claude's replies through a Stop hook, and script the full loop. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/self-hosted-environments-testing

skills.label: Settings files and precedence
skills.desc: Change Claude Code settings, pick the scope a key belongs in, verify the change, and learn which value Claude Code uses when a key is set in several places. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings

skills.label: Example settings files
skills.desc: Realistic settings.json files for a developer, a team, and an organization: copy one, keep the keys you want, and change the values. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-example

skills.label: All settings
skills.desc: Complete reference for every Claude Code settings.json key: where each one goes, its type and default, and a paste-ready example, with an index of every key. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference
